name: hexcoder-fulgoran-drones
title: Fulgoran Remnant - Vault Drones
author: Hexcoder
description:
Fulgora's Vault ruins show occasional remnants of activity...
Ancient defense drones are still active!
Kickstart your base with sparse scrap, then find ways to deal with the aggressive drones that keep emerging from vault ruins.
Their attacks will only disable your mining drills, never destroy them.
